proof_body:
by
  intro p hp
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    have h3 : ¬ 3 ∣ p := fun hd => hne ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_three hp).mp hd).symm
    have hmod : (p ^ 2 + 2) % 3 = 0 := by
      have : p % 3 = 1 ∨ p % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases this with h1 | h1 <;> simp [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod, h1]
    have hd : 3 ∣ p ^ 2 + 2 := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
    have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_three h).mp hd
    nlinarith [hp.two_le]
  · rintro rfl
    norm_num
